moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other.
moments.why: Trump floated the unorthodox idea of appointing UFC’s Dana White as press secretary—sparking amusement, confusion, and keen political chatter.

moments.author: Jakiyra Metcalf
moments.quote: A video of me being harassed outside my home by Ole Miss students making monkey sounds has been posted—this is disgusting behavior and they need to be identified.
moments.why: The footage of racial harassment near a Black student’s home at Ole Miss has ignited widespread outrage and campus accountability demands.

moments.author: UFC
moments.quote: WHAT A WAY TO START #UFCVegas124 🤯 @CanelaUFC23 lands the FLUSH RD1 knockout!
moments.why: A brutal first-round knockout by José “Canela” Souza opened UFC Vegas 124 in spectacular fashion, flooding social media with reaction clips.

moments.author: Markwayne Mullin
moments.why: DHS Secretary Mullin’s direct statement on X the day after midterms signals the administration doubling down on immigration enforcement—and sparked fierce debate.
